2. This writ petition has been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated
29.5.2022 in Case Crime No. 424 of 2022, under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 427 I.P.C. and
section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Kalyanpur, district-Kanpur Nagar.

3.
By producing a photostat copy of the order dated 10.7.2023 passed by Addl. Chief Metropolitan

Magistrate-II, Kanpur Nagar, learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that police has submitted final report no. 295 of 2022 on 27.11.2022 and the same has been accepted by the concerned trial court in the present case and as such, the cause for filing present writ petition no more survives.
4. In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
